decision: Scan set = 2026-08-31 Drive folder (named 'Huracan Evo Spider' on Drive, IDs as briefed); one rigid levelling transform (RANSAC ground plane -> +Z, long axis -> Y, nose at -Y) applied to every scan (tools/level.py, /home/user/media/huracan-evo/level.json)
why: Raw Artec frame was tilted ~7 deg (ground normal 0.011,0.119,0.993); one shared rigid transform keeps every part in the car's frame, same role as prep --like

decision: All 2026 part scans are registered to the full car - no ICP corrections applied, no 2023 parts mixed in
why: tools/regcheck.py at 8 mm: median part-to-car distance 2.5-3.4 mm (decimation noise floor), ICP would move parts <=16 mm/0.36 deg; cowls checked against 'Hood Open Cowl Exposed' (96-99% overlap, 2.1-2.4 mm). Visual overlays in /home/user/media/huracan-evo/chk/reg_*.png

decision: Exploded base = full car minus every panel the part scans cover (car tris within 6 mm of a part) + All-Parts-Removed tris >6 mm from the trimmed car, APR's propped hood dropped (tools/composite.py -> base.blend)
why: APR alone is a partial scan (no roof/cabin, hood propped open) so it can't carry the shot; lessons: use state scans as captured over the full car trimmed back. Base + all 8 parts at home renders as a complete car (test/asm2)

decision: Hood opens on a fitted hinge: axis X at y=-1.655 m z=0.961 m (prepped frame), -78 deg = APR's captured open hood (tools/hinge.py, median fit 1.98 mm)
why: Reference opens the hood in the front-end beat; fitting the hinge to the real open-hood capture makes the motion physically right instead of a guessed pivot

decision: Wheel close-up = front-right corner with the wheel off (Front Wheel Wells state scan, 2 mm) - brake disc, caliper, hub, suspension
why: Full-car scan never captured the dark rims (tyre ring + a few spoke fragments only); a close-up there would show a hollow wheel. The state scan is real detail from the data and plays as the ref's 'extreme close-up' beat

decision: Exploded layout stacks panels above the car (bumpers +0.95-1.0 m up, hood 1.6 m, cowls 0.8-0.95 m, fender/skirt out 0.5 m and up)
why: First framing test flew bumpers along the car's length and out of the 9:16 frame; ref 28-31 s floats panels above the car; lesson: keep parts from flying at the lens

decision: Look: house silver, flat shading, exposure -0.5 EV; 2 mm full car for s1-s3, 3 mm composite for exploded shots
why: Measured car-pixel luma vs Temerario crop: 0 EV median 208 / p90 239 (roof clipped), -0.5 EV median 198 / p90 233 vs ref 200 / 231. Ref speckle is that car's dusty capture; this Huracan export is cleaner, 2 mm gives a bit more grille/vent detail

decision: Hollow wheels accepted (no fix); framing keeps wheels small/in shadow
why: Both the 2026 and the 2023 full-car scans captured only tyre rings + spoke fragments (dark rims); inventing wheels would misrepresent the scan data
